name: marketplace-content
description: The marketplace: discover, buy, trade, list, and withdraw dDRM assets (content today; apps & games later, same storefront). A pure UI shell — reads listings from elastos://market/* (re-derivable index over content-market's chain-truth decode), requests UNSIGNED orders, and routes all signing to the wallet. On buy it TRIGGERS a pin of the encrypted asset into the local Library; opening is handed off to the runtime player (POST /api/viewers/open) and minting to the creator app. Mints nothing, plays/renders nothing, holds NO signer, token, CEK, chain RPC, or mutation handle (Principle 16).
author: elastos
